title: a layer rule broken, or a new import cycle
how: static import / export-from specifiers of the JS files under roots, resolved relative to the file: a forbidden edge, or a cycle (a strongly connected group) the base did not have

head.engine/lib/a.mjs:
import { x } from '../bin/x.mjs';
export const a = x;

base.engine/lib/a.mjs:
import { b } from './b.mjs';
export const a = () => b;
base.engine/lib/b.mjs:
import { a } from './a.mjs';
export const b = () => a;

head.engine/lib/a.mjs:
import { b } from './b.mjs';
export const a = () => b();
head.engine/lib/b.mjs:
import { a } from './a.mjs';
export const b = () => a;
head.engine/bin/x.mjs:
import { a } from '../lib/a.mjs';
export const x = a;
